messages.text: Do you see your daughter more?

Honestly? At month 2, learned the best hours to drive [E-A-001]. Most of what I'm learning is bookkeeping and taxes [ev_A_006]. My role these days: experienced driver, some regular clients [ev_A_006]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. At month 5, picked up extra shifts [E-B-001]. Most of what I'm learning is leading a shift [ev_B_005]. My role these days: shift lead or certified tradesperson [ev_B_005]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: no benefits; income drops when the car or the app does [ev_A_010]. Stress? medium [ev_A_009]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
